reuse.why: Edits the existing getExpectedAmount helper that all schedule amount consumers (forecast, schedule-template, schedules app, getScheduledAmount) already route through, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule changes in its one definition; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Change stays in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount rule lives.

scope.why: Only the helper, its doc comment and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold express 'lowest allowed value' directly and the doc comment is updated.
